card.name: Words inside web addresses
card.fires_on: Words or word pieces inside URL paths in citations, just before an underscore, slash or hyphen that joins the next part. Also seen in hyphenated technical option names.

modes.label: URL path pieces
modes.description: A word or piece inside a web address path in a reference, right before a joining character.

modes.label: Technical hyphenated names
modes.description: A piece of a hyphenated configuration or command option name.

card.writes: It pushes up code-like identifier pieces and suppresses hyphenated and code suffixes, with no clear shared meaning.
card.plain: It marks a word in the middle of a web address in a citation, where the address continues with a joining mark.
